data.name: Patriots-Seahawks Opener Draws 25.1 Million Viewers, Lowest Since 2022

Patriots coach Mike Vrabel stood by his run-heavy plan, quipping that throwing 45 times rarely wins unless you're Tom Brady.

data.hook: Sam Darnold powered Seattle to a Week 1 win, but an early glute tweak has him sidelined—and insiders can't agree on how long.
data.name: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold Out for Week 2 with Glute Injury
data.summary: The Seahawks quarterback suffered a glute injury, initially called a hip issue, during their victory over the New England Patriots. Ian Rapoport clarified it's a muscular butt injury, with Darnold expected to miss at least Week 2 against Arizona but possibly back for Week 3 versus Washington. Conflicting reports from Mike Florio cite a four-to-six week timeline after four second opinions, though team sources call it a short-term soft-tissue problem and emphasize caution without surgery. Backup Drew Lock starts Sunday as Seattle monitors Darnold's Super Bowl-winning starter.

data.hook: On his first day as a CBS Sports analyst, Russell Wilson dropped a bold take: Bengals QB Joe Burrow might bolt Cincinnati if they falter again this year.
data.name: Russell Wilson Predicts Joe Burrow Could Leave Bengals If Season Struggles
data.summary: Wilson, fresh off joining CBS's NFL pregame show, said Burrow seems tired of losing and wants out if 2026 doesn't deliver. Burrow has pushed back hard, telling reporters he's in Cincinnati for the long haul under his $275 million contract through 2029. The Bengals went 6-11 last season due to Burrow's injury but added defensive help like Dexter Lawrence to fuel a playoff push, while fans and analysts quickly dismissed Wilson's hot take.
